answer: The anchor schedule is applied in umber and tide makes public each instalment. An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split which means 51% arrives at settlement and the rest over 11 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1766 identities would post 4857 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
